Super Abstimmungen  super Gegend  gerne wieder

I had a great stay in this apartment in Berlin. It has a very good location, easy to reach by public transportation. Apartment itself is in a very good condition and well equiped.  brThe host was lovely. She contacted me shortly after booking and on the day of my arrival made sure I found my way to the address. It was far greater than what we expected. Everything was there in good condition. Also, it was quite cold when I visited Berlin, yet the house was so warm and comfy. I really hope I stay again at here. The location was excellent as well. Imme was so welcoming too.
DIe Wohnung von Julia ist eine toll eingerichtete Wohnung mit tollen Ausblick und in bester Lage. Sehr empfehlenswert

Everything was really nice. The apartment was beautiful, recently renovated and very clean. The view from the window was gorgeous and there was a nice balcony. The other housemate was great at giving suggestions about where to go and what to see. The neighborhood was quiet, safe, and near a metro station, which was very convenient.

Die Unterkunft entsprach vollkommen der Beschreibung. Die Nachbarschaft war sehr freundlich. Besonders gut gefallen hat mir viel Platz im Zimmer, sowie Bad und praktische Einrichtung der Küche. Ausserdem ist die Lage der Wohnung zentral

Yaz was a superb host He gave us wonderful bar and restaurant recommendations, was very responsive and made our check in and check out very easy. The apartment is in a great location, close to everything. Would highly recommend Thanks Yaz
Antonias place is lovely, with great light and easy access to the metro line. Also very close to Schönefeld airport. She was very easy to communicate with.
Janet was very flexible when I communicated my arrival time in advance and was patient when communicating with my less than average spanish and non existent german.
Wunderschönes keines Pavillon, super ruhig und sehr geschmackvoll eingerichtet brTolle Details und schöne Atmosphäre.brAngelika ist sehr zuvorkommend und professionell.

This was our first visit to Berlin and we couldnt have scored a more perfect abode. From Stefans perfectly appointed studio apartment to its location near several of the citys most iconic restaurants, shops and sites. Super schöne Wohnung in bester und schönster Lage. Die Gastgeber sind super nett, schnell und hilfsbereit. Zum Abschied gab es sogar eine Tüte mit Proviant für die Heimfahrt. Sofort wieder
Me and my five friends had a really good weekend in Julias apartment. Close to the Ubahn, and a nice area in Berlin to live in.
Schöner Charme geht durchs ganze Haus. Sehr nette Gastgeber.

It was a great experience. The flat is in a very nice area with lots of cafes and restaurants and very close to the tram and metro station. Very easy to get from the airport. Everything was just like the pictures and all amenities work fine.

Super Lage zu dem Preis mit einer tollen Gastfreundschaft Gerne wieder :)

1010 This place is awesome. Super cozy appartement. I felt like home. The city transportation is really close, the area have everything you could need. I really enjoyed my stay. There is no doubt this is a good place

Marine was great Very understanding and responsive. House is amazing Great location and very nice inside.
Bianca is very kind. The place is lovely and well located
Eine schöne Unterkunft mitten in Berlin und freundliche und hilfreiche Gastgeberin. Ich war zwei Nächte für Dienstreise in Berlin, habe mich sehr wohlgefühlt und würde jederzeit wieder buchen.

Schönes und gemütliches Appartement mit allem, was man benötigt. Sehr schön eingerichtet mit viel Komfort. Nikos sppartemrnt is situated in one of the best areas of the city, its clean, quiet and stylish. Loved it a lot

Julias apartment is beautiful She is obviously a true yogi and the space is peaceful, warm (we were there in winter) and totally (Hidden by Airbnb) able. Sehr saubere Unterkunft, CheckIn verlief ohne Probleme und sehr freundlich. Leider hatten wir noch andere Gäste in der Unterkunft, die sehr laut waren.

The hosts very much made me feel welcome and at home.

Vladimirs apartment is in an excellent central location with easy access to local transportation.  It is more spacious than it appears in photographs, impeccably clean and very comfortable.  Most importantly, it represents great value.
Henrik was warm and inviting. The place was in a great location for sightseeing and was priced accordingly.
Great place, perfect location and really reliable, friendly, and fun hosts. Immediately and clear communication and a very nice place to stay.

Magdalenas place was conveniently located close to lots of public transportation. It was clean and cozy. I did not get a chance to meet Magdalena but she was very helpful and gave me direction on how to get to her place from the airport.

We had a great stay in Katharinas apartment the location was great, and the room was clean and nice.

Super host and super comfy and quiet space. Everything was just perfect and Max is attentive to every need even before you tell him, from coffee machine to toilet papers. Neighboorhood is so nice, all green and birds singing Prenzlauer Berg and its vegan cafés are within a short distance.

value for money, big room(2) and perfect location
